scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run validate:workflows && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && env PORT=8081 BASE_PATH=/__mockup pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run build && env PORT=22972 BASE_PATH=/admin-portal/ pnpm --filter @workspace/travel-land-admin run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/travel-land-app run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
